mechanismsConsidered.name: row exists for that prop_id at any other tax_year
mechanismsConsidered.verdict: REJECTED - measurably vacuous, and vacuous by construction not by accident
mechanismsConsidered.evidence: Live anti-join over all 10 declared-vintage counties that carry conformant cad-parcel-roll atoms (48021, 48027, 48029, 48055, 48085, 48091, 48209, 48309, 48453, 48491; 2,875,485 distinct atom prop_ids): the count of atom prop_ids with NO cad_property row at ANY tax_year is 0 in every single county. For the three counties that produce retirements the absent-at-declared-vintage populations are 48491 282,570 / 48209 38,444 / 48055 267, and M1 classifies 100 percent of all 321,281 of them as was-on-a-roll-once. It would change nothing and fix nothing while reading as a fix.
mechanismsConsidered.whyStructural: the parcel nodes are atoms of entity_type cad-parcel-roll generated FROM cad_property. A prop_id can therefore never be an atom without having been a cad_property row at some tax_year. M1's discriminating branch is unreachable by construction, so its negative-case violation test can never fire on real data.
mechanismsConsidered.consequenceIfTaken: all 282,570 Williamson rows and 38,060 of the 38,444 Hays rows keep the fabricated split-merged-renumbered-or-removed basis.

mechanismsConsidered.name: per-row prior-appraisal evidence across ALL vintages held for the county, via the fields the StratMap/TxGIO geometry loader structurally cannot populate
mechanismsConsidered.derivation: lib/cad-ingest/src/txgio/landuse.ts normalizeStratMapLandUse hardcodes assessedValue: null, exemptionCodes: null, livingAreaSqft: null on EVERY StratMap row, unconditionally. lib/cad-ingest/src/p78Merge.ts keeps those three in COALESCE_FIELDS so a prior genuine CAD value survives a StratMap re-apply on ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE, while source_file and source_vintage are overwritten unconditionally (applyPathAMerge, p78Merge.ts:196-197). Presence of any one of the three, at ANY tax_year, is therefore positive proof that some genuine CAD export wrote this prop_id as an appraisal account.
mechanismsConsidered.supersetOfCtxB1: CTX-B1 used assessed_value alone. M2 uses assessed_value OR living_area_sqft OR exemption_codes, all three StratMap-impossible; the union is strictly more sensitive and cannot produce a false positive that assessed_value alone would not.
mechanismsConsidered.asymmetryDeclaredNotHidden: presence PROVES a prior appraisal account. ABSENCE proves only that no vintage held for the county carries appraisal-only evidence for this prop_id; it does not prove the account never existed. The basis text for that population is written to say exactly that and no more.
mechanismsConsidered.independentAgreement: the Hays 384 / 38,060 split reproduces CTX-HAYS-SPLIT's figure exactly, derived here by a different instrument (three-field union over a full cross-vintage scan) than that lane's (assessed_value alone over a 2025-vs-2026 anti-join).

mechanismsConsidered.name: keep source_file / source_vintage as the lineage discriminator
mechanismsConsidered.why: already disproven upstream. p78Merge.ts applyPathAMerge overwrites sourceFile and sourceVintage unconditionally on the ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE path, so a genuine CAD row touched by the 2026-08-25 P-78 StratMap apply now reads as StratMap. chosenShape.noSecondAbsenceStateInvented: honours the CTX-B1 / operator ruling A1 constraint. There remains exactly ONE record-level state, Tier1RecordRetirement. What changes is that its basis stops being a fixed causal assertion and becomes derived per row from evidence, plus a machine-readable discriminator so a consumer never has to parse prose.
chosenShape.newRequiredField: priorRollEvidence, a four-value discriminated union on Tier1RecordRetirement

values.prior-appraisal-account: at least one vintage held for this county carries an appraisal-only field for this prop_id. The ONLY population that keeps the existing split-merged-renumbered-or-removed basis.
values.no-appraisal-record-in-any-vintage: rows exist at other vintages but not one carries an appraisal-only field. Basis says only what is held and claims no roll departure.
values.no-record-in-any-vintage: no cad_property row at any tax_year. Measured 0 today in all 10 counties and structurally unreachable while nodes are generated from cad_property; kept as its own value so the count is VISIBLE rather than folded into a neighbour if that ever changes.
values.not-consulted: the cross-vintage evidence input was not supplied. The honest UNMEASURED state, distinct from both absences per ENFORCEMENT absent-zero-and-unmeasured-are-three-different-states. Its basis makes no claim in either direction. The bake CLI wires the real fetcher so a production bake can never land here.

chosenShape.predicateTightens: isEarnedRecordRetirement requires priorRollEvidence to be one of the four. Admitting an object without it would be exactly the presence-shaped widening ENFORCEMENT forbids: a pre-CTX-B5 payload carrying the fabricated basis would keep buying the serve-guard tolerance.

threeQuestionGate.whatExecutes: isEarnedRecordRetirement (recordRetirement.ts), called by refusePayloadAtServe at serve and by hauska-factory verify-walk.mjs at grade time; plus a new assertRecordRetirementEarned in the bake CLI write path, which refuses the INSERT.
threeQuestionGate.whatTriggers: every serve of a tier1 payload, every walk of a parcel whose payload carries recordRetirement, and every row the conformant bake writes.
threeQuestionGate.whatFails: serve throws SITUS_PUNCTUATION_ONLY instead of exempting; the walk grades the row on ordinary BP-CONTENT-01 instead of RECORD_RETIRED; the bake refuses the row rather than writing it. The bake refusal is the new one and it runs in the same CLI path the four existing assertions already run in.
threeQuestionGate.whatBypasses: a writer that does not go through nodeFacetBakeTier1ConformantCli (for instance nodeFacetPatchCadRollFromCadPropertyCli, which patches cadRoll fields only and never writes recordRetirement), and any direct SQL UPDATE of place_layer_snapshots.payload_json. Named, not claimed absent.
